decisions.reason: Removing quotation marks from one Mama's Hot Take section does not change paragraph spacing or body-page density.
The candidate already has a complete message-154 MODIFY recording removal of the Mama's Hot Take outer quotation marks, along with the other manuscript corrections from that source.
The source changes quotation-mark treatment in a Mama's Hot Take section, not Chapter 18 heading or subtitle typography.
The punctuation and quotation-mark correction has no effect on chapter-image distortion, cropping, or pixelation requirements.
Removing enclosing quotation marks does not change the justified body-text alignment decision.
The source decision does not alter pagination, table-of-contents page numbers, or their update timing.
The section-level quotation-mark correction does not change the paperback format or trim size.
The source does not change chapter-image inclusion, coverage, placement, presentation, or image selection.

The source reports concrete punctuation corrections but does not change the candidate's general copyediting goal or its approved passage requirements; its existing runtime observation must not be propagated as requirement-state modification.
Quotation marks around a Mama's Hot Take section are unrelated to the unintended newline marker in the book title.
The source does not affect illustration suitability, source, tone, or colour-palette criteria.
The Mama's Hot Take quotation-mark treatment does not change copyright-page alignment.
